newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt extends deadline for 50,000T French wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt extends deadline for 50,000T French wheat.

text.p: Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Friday he was extending the deadline to buy 50,000 tonnes of soft red French wheat until Sunday September 15.
Samir el-Shakankiri, vice chairman of the General Authority for Supply Commodities, told Reuters the extension was designed to attract cheaper prices.
"The prices we got are not bad but we want better," Shakankiri said.
The original deadline for bids was 0700 GMT on Friday. --Miral Fahmy +202 578 3290/91
